known_secrets.text: Cattle grazed near the Old Canal Bed fall ill significantly more often than elsewhere.
This illness pattern has persisted for over a decade, tracked in her private records.
She gave copies of her illness maps to Elira.
She reported the pattern to Tarek Sabha years ago and nothing was done.

unknowns: The true cause of the illness clustering near the Old Canal Bed
Whether it connects to the same cause as the failing terraces and thinning woodland
Meaning of the Signs on the seals
